description.value:
You serve as an Imperial Knight, a Force-wielding protector whose order blends Jedi-style discipline with unwavering loyalty to the Empire it serves. Your order treats the Force as a tool of duty rather than philosophy, rejecting the dark side's temptations without adopting the Jedi's teachings either.

Your uniform armor and lightsaber mark you at a glance as one of the Emperor's own, and even citizens who've never heard of your order extend you the deference that comes with it.

system.equipment: An Imperial insignia, a black hooded cape, and a belt pouch containing 100 credits.
